Description: OUR ALIGNMENT, NOT THE AUTHORS'. Task and eye-movement events for runs (or phases) that the main per-run events.tsv files leave out, built by code/fix-20261031_events_our_alignment.py. Event content (trials, EyeLink fixations, saccades, blinks and behavioural columns) is the same as in the main tables (code/fix-20261030_events.py, port of the authors' create_events.m); only the time base differs: instead of the authors' fixed sync-pulse indices, a linear map from the EyeLink clock to the run's time (onset = a + b x EyeLink time) is fitted by least squares on EyeLink trial messages paired with sync pulses found by search, and every event is placed through that map. sub-01 recognition phase: map fitted on the same run's study phase. Method, acceptance criteria and per-run residuals: README.md and alignment_residuals.tsv in this folder.

onset.Description: Event onset relative to the first sample of the run: EyeLink time of the event mapped through the run's fitted clock map (see column alignment); recog/sync_pulse rows: the sync-pulse onset itself.

duration.Description: Eye events: EyeLink end time minus start time. Trials and sync pulses: n/a.

trial_type.Description: <phase>/<type> as in the authors' events structure (fields phase and type), plus recog/sync_pulse.

Levels.encode/trial: Study trial; onset = EyeLink 'encode' trial message mapped to the run (in the runs the main tables cover this message coincides with the pre-cue sync pulse within the residuals listed in the README).
Levels.recog/trial: Recognition test trial; onset = EyeLink 'recog' trial message mapped to the run. In sub-01 this message precedes the recognition sync pulse by 0.8-1.2 s (see recog/sync_pulse and README).
Levels.encode/fixation: Fixation during a study trial (EyeLink ENDFIX event).
Levels.encode/saccade: Saccade during a study trial (EyeLink ENDSACC event, saccades ending right after a blink excluded).
Levels.encode/blink: Blink during a study trial (EyeLink ENDBLINK event).
Levels.recog/saccade: Saccade during a recognition trial (blink-related saccades excluded).
Levels.recog/sync_pulse: sub-01 only: the recognition-phase sync pulse paired with this trial (pulse onset as in get_onsets.m). In every other participant this pulse coincides with the 'recog' message; in sub-01 it follows it by a block-constant 0.8-1.2 s.

sample.Description: Onset as a 0-based sample index of the run's iEEG data file (onset x sampling rate, rounded; onset is written as sample / sampling rate).

block.Description: EyeLink/behavioural block whose events these are, identified by the alignment (it can differ from the run number: sub-06 run-01 = block 2, sub-06 run-02 = block 3, the block run-03 also covers).

trial.Description: Trial number within the phase of the block (authors' field trial: index of the EyeLink recording period, 1-24 at study, 1-48 at test).

stim_id.Description: Microsoft COCO 2017 train image id of the scene (authors' field stim_idx, looked up in data/behav/S<N>/S<N>_stim_array*.txt; the released arrays hold file names 000000<id>.jpg).

condition.Description: Authors' field condition: row of the stimulus array (column 2 of S<N>_enc_array/S<N>_rec_array). The release does not name the rows.

old.Description: Authors' field old: column 3 of the encoding/recognition array, OR-ed with whether the scene was shown in an earlier block (create_events.m).

cue_salience.Description: Authors' field salience: column 4 of the encoding/recognition array. compute_recog_performance.m labels 1 as high- and 0 as low-salience cue (DeepGaze II).

response.Description: Recognition response code from S<N>_output_array.txt column 5 (authors' field resp); n/a at study. compute_recog_performance.m treats 1 as a 'repeated' judgement, 4 as a 'novel' judgement and 2 as missing.

response_time.Description: Recognition response time from S<N>_output_array.txt column 2 (authors' field rt, in ms), converted to seconds; n/a at study.

eyelink_time.Description: EyeLink tracker clock time of the event start (trials: the 'encode'/'recog' message), as in the EDF file. n/a for recog/sync_pulse rows.

start_x.Description: Gaze x at event start (EyeLink gstx), screen coordinates (DISPLAY_COORDS 0 0 1920 1080). n/a for trials and blinks (EyeLink stores no gaze position for blinks; 0 in every blink record of this release).

start_y.Description: Gaze y at event start (EyeLink gsty). n/a for trials and blinks.

end_x.Description: Gaze x at event end (EyeLink genx). n/a for trials and blinks.

end_y.Description: Gaze y at event end (EyeLink geny). n/a for trials and blinks.

mean_x.Description: Average gaze x over the event (EyeLink gavx). n/a for trials, saccades and blinks (EyeLink stores no average for these; 0 in every such record of this release).

mean_y.Description: Average gaze y over the event (EyeLink gavy). n/a for trials, saccades and blinks.

alignment.Description: How the onset was obtained (our alignment).

Levels.pulse_search_clock_fit: EyeLink clock map fitted on the trial messages of this run paired with sync pulses found by search (both phases jointly when both pass).
Levels.eyelink_clock_from_encoding: sub-01 recognition phase: EyeLink clock map fitted on the study phase of the same run, applied to the recognition events.
Levels.sync_pulse_paired: recog/sync_pulse rows: onset of the paired sync pulse (no mapping).
